name: lexiquest
description: Root scripts only. The real projects are api/ (Azure Functions, TypeScript) and frontend/ (React + Vite). No workspaces: Azure Static Web Apps builds api/ and frontend/ in isolation and a workspace root would hoist the API's dependencies out of api/ on deploy.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix api ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix frontend ci --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:frontend
scripts.build: npm --prefix api run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
